name: Istrian identity
summary: Istrian identity (Istrianism) is a regionalist identity of the Croatian part of Istria, politically carried mainly by the Istrian Democratic Assembly. It stresses a distinct multicultural and bilingual (Croatian and Italian) region, anti-fascism, human rights and decentralization within Croatia, and sits in a pro-European, centre to centre-left liberal frame. It is not secessionist and opposes ethnic nationalism.
scope: The mainstream political Istrianism of the Istrian Democratic Assembly (IDS/DDI) since 1990, as documented by Wikipedia, an IDS statement by Valter Flego and scholarship by Zorko and Fontana. Economic and social-policy answers beyond regionalism are mostly inferred from the party's centre-left social-liberal label and are low confidence; the profile excludes Italian and Slovene Istria and irredentist currents.

universal-healthcare.rationale: IDS is a centre to centre-left social-liberal party and Croatia already has a public health system; support is inferred, not a documented IDS plank.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: As a social-liberal centre-left party in the Kukuriku coalition it would likely back higher wages, but no source states a position.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: IDS protects private property and runs tourism-led policy but is social-liberal; sources give no stand on markets versus planning.

public-ownership.rationale: Nothing in the sources addresses public ownership of utilities; a social-liberal party could go either way.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred from the centre-left social-liberal label; no documented tax program.

unions-good.rationale: Centre-left social-liberal parties are generally union-friendly; the sources are silent on labour.

property-fundamental.rationale: Protection of private property is listed among the IDS core principles, though not as an absolute override-proof right.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The sources do not address corporate regulation; liberal pro-business tourism policy pulls against social-liberal instincts.

cut-welfare.rationale: A centre-left social-liberal party would not frame welfare as dependency; inferred, not documented.

worker-ownership.rationale: Istrian regionalism centres on territory and identity, not worker ownership; a liberal party protecting private property would not endorse it.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Human rights and liberties are core IDS principles, so broad surveillance is inferred to be disfavoured.

legalize-drugs.rationale: No source addresses drug policy; liberal and Catholic-tradition wings of the electorate likely split.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Anti-fascism is a core principle, which suggests support for restricting fascist and hate propaganda; inferred.

strong-leader.rationale: IDS defined itself against Tudjman's hard-line nationalist rule and champions democracy and decentralization, so bypassing gridlock via a strongman is disfavoured.

state-harmful.rationale: IDS is a governing party that wants a stronger regional state and EU integration; the idea that the state is harmful is alien to it.

limit-guns.rationale: Inferred from a liberal pro-European profile; not documented.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred from the human-rights, anti-nationalist emphasis; not documented.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Not addressed; liberal and Catholic-tradition wings differ.

decide-locally.rationale: Valter Flego says decentralization must start being applied in practice as soon as possible, and Istria wants more powers and responsibility for its own development.

rehabilitation.rationale: Human-rights liberalism suggests rehabilitation; no source discusses penal policy.

traditional-family.rationale: IDS is secular-liberal yet also defends Christian tradition in Istria per scholarship, so adherents are split; no direct source opened.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Liberal and human-rights profile suggests support, but the party has not made it a central stand in the sources.

abortion-legal.rationale: Secular liberal orientation suggests support; not documented, and Catholic inland voters differ.

more-religion-public.rationale: Secularism is part of Istrian regional consciousness per summaries of the identity; inferred.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Not applicable to the Istrian context; no position documented.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Not addressed in any source; adherents unlikely to have a unified view.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The identity is about preserving a distinct regional culture and its bilingual heritage; it applies to the Istrian region rather than a nation, so only partly literal.

gradual-change.rationale: Centrist, coalition-minded and EU-oriented, so incremental reform is likely preferred; inferred.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Multicultural, tolerant self-image (Flego: multiculturalism a signpost for Croatia) suggests opposition to cutting immigration; immigration itself not discussed.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: IDS is pro-European and joined ALDE, favouring supranational cooperation; the UN specifically is not discussed.

free-trade.rationale: Pro-European liberal party likely favours open trade, and Istria depends on tourism; inferred.

nation-first.rationale: IDS opposed Tudjman-style nationalism and is pro-European, so putting national interests above cooperation is disfavoured.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Not addressed; liberal human-rights views are offset by caution.

open-borders.rationale: IDS wants a cross-border Istrian euro-region, which points toward open borders, but a general open-borders goal is not documented.

limit-growth.rationale: Tourism-driven development is central to Istria; limits on growth are unlikely to be endorsed.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Liberal ALDE-aligned party; not documented in the sources.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Equal spouses are consistent with a liberal profile but never stated.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Pro-EU, tolerant; not documented beyond EU citizens.

rent-control.rationale: Rent regulation is not discussed in the sources.

abolish-ip.rationale: Abolishing patents is not an IDS idea in the sources.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Nuclear basing is not discussed in the sources.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Foreign basing is not discussed in the sources.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Anti-fascist and human-rights stance suggests support; not documented.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Distributive principles are not discussed in the sources.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Absolute pacifism is not an IDS idea in the sources.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Zorko and Fontana show Istrianism is ambivalent, constructed and multi-ethnic, not an unbroken ancient national line.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Gender theory is not discussed in the sources.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Feminist theory is not discussed in the sources.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Diaspora relations are not discussed in the sources.

culture-before-state.rationale: Cultural nationalism sequencing is not discussed in the sources.

god-not-male.rationale: Feminist theology is not discussed in the sources.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Feminist theology is not discussed in the sources.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Istrian identity is regional, not one-people-one-unit; IDS wants a cross-border Istrian region which comes close but is multi-ethnic.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Socialist definition debates are not part of this liberal identity.

second-chamber.rationale: Bicameralism is not discussed in the sources.

municipal-property.rationale: Municipalist ownership is not an IDS idea in the sources.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Decentralization is core but confederal municipalism is a specific anarchist idea.

family-wage.rationale: Wage-setting for families is not discussed in the sources.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Drug approval policy is not discussed in the sources.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Longevity research is not discussed in the sources.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Financial privacy is not discussed in the sources.

online-anonymity.rationale: Online pseudonymity is not discussed in the sources.

person-over-state.rationale: Unconditional respect for human rights suggests it; not stated in these terms.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Not addressed; scholarship notes both Christian and secular wings.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: The aim is greater powers and responsibility for Istria, so revocable devolution contradicts its demand.

gm-crops.rationale: Genetically modified crops are not discussed in the sources.

dense-cities.rationale: Urban density is not discussed in the sources.

racial-pride.rationale: Not addressed but opposed to racial politics.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Liberal outlook suggests it, but no source states a position.

communal-electorates.rationale: Separate electorates are not discussed in the sources; regional minority representation is a different matter.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Istrian identity unites Croats and Italians and others across languages, rejecting language-defined nations.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Conspiracy thinking about partition is not part of IDS.

free-public-college.rationale: University tuition is not discussed in the sources.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Environmental taxation is not discussed in the sources.

future-generations.rationale: Intergenerational duty is plausible for a liberal party but is not stated.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Difference feminism is not discussed in the sources.

arms-reduction.rationale: Arms control is not discussed in the sources.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Refusal of orders is not an IDS idea in the sources.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Wage-setting is not discussed in the sources.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Tax credits are not discussed in the sources.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Debt rules are not discussed in the sources.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: International economic order is not discussed in the sources.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Voluntary economic polycentrism is not discussed in the sources.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Natural capital accounting is not discussed in the sources.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Student loans are not discussed in the sources.

internal-colonialism.rationale: IDS left the national government in 2001 over Istria's treatment and calls for decentralization and retaining revenue, implying grievance at central dominance; the colonial analogy itself is not stated.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Philosophical anthropology is not discussed in the sources.

public-service-media.rationale: Public broadcasting is not discussed in the sources.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Perennialism is not discussed in the sources.

farm-price-support.rationale: Farm price support is not discussed in the sources.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Nuclear arsenals do not concern this movement in the sources.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Dialect and language naming is not discussed in the sources.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Libertarian tort law is not discussed in the sources.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Not applicable and contrary to democratic principles.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Environment-liberty trade-offs are not discussed in the sources.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Sentencing law is not discussed in the sources.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Bilingual Istria promotes language equality; a requirement is not stated.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Right-to-work is not discussed in the sources.

voter-id.rationale: Voter ID is not discussed in the sources.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Liberal democratic; not documented in these terms.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Human rights principles oppose cutting internet access for order.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Negative income tax is not discussed in the sources.

women-suffrage.rationale: Basic democratic liberal rights are core.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Religion's effect on women is not discussed; Catholic tradition has a place in Istria.

race-social-construct.rationale: Race theory is not discussed in the sources.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Not addressed by IDS; Istria's twentieth-century border changes are a sensitive history that the opened sources do not discuss.

land-use-tenure.rationale: A party that lists protection of private property as a core principle rejects tenure by use only.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Anti-nationalist, pro-European liberal party opposes great-power coercion of allies.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the IDS's liberal, centre-left frame, which accepts private property but not a pure first-claim rule; not a stated plank.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred from the party's pro-European, human-rights liberalism as stated by Flego; no source discusses international courts.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Inferred from the party's secular, multicultural liberal outlook; scripture is not an IDS topic.

gendered-self-government.rationale: Inferred from the party's human-rights and equality commitments; no source addresses self-government for Indigenous groups.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Inferred from the party's liberal, private-property and anti-authoritarian stance; a planned state is outside its programme.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred from the party's liberal democratic frame, which favours direct elections; not a stated position.

national-church-status.rationale: Inferred from the party's multicultural, anti-clerical-leaning liberalism and its stress on equal minorities.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: IDS backs regional decentralisation and minority rights within Croatia, so territorial autonomy for minority-majority regions fits, though it is inferred rather than stated.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Inferred from the party's democratic, self-determination-friendly liberalism, which opposes irredentism; no source states it.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Inferred from the party's non-irredentist, pro-European stance that favours stable borders over redrawing them.

simple-living.rationale: Inferred from the party's modern pro-European, market-friendly liberalism; not a stated position.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: Inferred from the party's liberal open-region outlook; Istrianism is itself a mixed-settlement identity.

equal-conscription.rationale: Inferred from the party's liberal egalitarianism; conscription is not an IDS issue.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Istrianism stresses attachment to a distinct region and its heritage, though the framing is civic and regional rather than spiritual; this is inferred.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: IDS stresses human rights and a pro-European liberal frame, which rule out killing without trial.

close-ties-china.rationale: The party is strongly pro-European and Western-oriented; disagreement is inferred from that orientation.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Istrianism is itself about a multicultural region and opposes ethnic nationalism, yet supports minority rights generally; the kin-state framing is not discussed.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Nothing in the sources addresses the question; a centre-left liberal party is split on it.

self-ownership.rationale: A social-liberal human-rights stance implies bodily and personal autonomy, though this is inferred from its liberal label.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: The sources give no tax programme beyond centre-left social liberalism, so no clear position is inferred.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: A centre-left party might favour either universal or targeted provision, and the sources do not say.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: IDS is itself a party built on regional pluralism and democratic decentralization, so bypassing parties is contrary to its approach.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Anti-corruption and liberal-democratic values suggest agreement, but the sources do not discuss this; it is inferred.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Istrianism is multicultural, anti-fascist and not religion-based, and IDS is a secular regionalist party, though denominations are not explicitly addressed.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: The sources do not address this; the party's regional heritage and modern European outlook point both ways.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Liberal, pro-European and human-rights values imply equal divorce rights, and Croatian law already provides them; this is inferred.

national-resource-control.rationale: Istrianism favours regional powers over development, and the sources do not say whether resources should be national or foreign controlled.

distribution-by-process.rationale: IDS protects private property but is centre-left social-liberal; no source addresses process versus equality in distribution, so adherents are not clearly one way.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Inferred from the IDS pro-European, centre-left social-liberal frame; no source mentions a financial transactions tax.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Istrianism is about a regional, not racial, identity and the sources never discuss racial disadvantage; no clear position can be inferred.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: Inferred from the IDS emphasis on anti-fascism and human rights, which implies law answers to rights; not stated in the sources.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Nothing in the sources addresses automation or working time, and a centre-left tourism-led party is not clearly for or against.

multipolar-world.rationale: Inferred from the IDS pro-European, Western-integrationist liberalism, which favours the EU bloc over a multipolar order; the sources do not discuss it.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: A liberal party defending private property is unlikely to hold a labour theory of value; inferred, not stated.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: IDS is regionalist and sceptical of ethnic nationalism while centre-left on workers; no source ties patriotism to workers, so it is split.

material-over-identity.rationale: Identity, multiculturalism and minority rights are central to Istrianism, so a push to set cultural identity aside is inferred to be disliked.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: IDS is a liberal-democratic party with anti-authoritarian values and no communist-party-led model; inferred from its liberal frame.

missingStatements.text: Two official languages should have equal status in a region where both communities live.
missingStatements.rationale: Equal status of Italian and Croatian in Istria is a core IDS policy and Flego names Istrian bilingualism as a signpost.

missingStatements.text: Regions should have the right to a larger share of political and fiscal powers within their country.
missingStatements.rationale: IDS advocates decentralization of Croatia and Flego calls for regional powers and responsibility for development.

missingStatements.text: Neighbouring regions across a national border should form joint cross-border regions with shared institutions.
missingStatements.rationale: IDS promotes a cross-border Istrian euro-region and the Adriatic Euroregion.
missingStatements.declined: Cross-border euroregions are a narrow European policy.

notes: Many answers outside regionalism, multiculturalism, anti-fascism and EU integration are low confidence inferences from the centre-left social-liberal label. Scholarship notes IDS also defends Christian tradition among inland voters, so social-issue answers are split-prone.
